label: GOD_NAMING_1 node from the box K node and the two transworld description bridges
meaning: If the box K node holds (some actual root n that is GOD_4, the one GOD_4, with the classical attributes, exists at every accessible world), whatever is GOD_4 satisfies the God-description at every accessible world where it exists, and nothing else existing there satisfies it without being GOD_4, then at every accessible world n alone, among the beings existing there, satisfies the God-description: the descriptive reading of 'God exists necessarily'. Shows what the descriptive reading adds to the route's de re node; establishes no premise.

strong_version_needed.cdf897a8-5490-561a-b9d2-507486a3f192: The proof uses the root n's existence at each accessible world v (hNec v hv) to name n there. NecessaryRootDeDictoK (0efe7b16) gives only that something exists at each accessible world, not n. NecessaryRootTertiaVia (32a2f51c) gives only ¬◇¬(n exists), which yields existence at v only by double-negation elimination; this zero-axiom result has no excluded-middle premise.
